verses.english: Numbered Discourses 8.78
8. Pairs
Good Enough

verses.pali: Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi …pe…
verses.english: There Sāriputta addressed the mendicants:

verses.pali: chahāvuso, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṁ attano, alaṁ paresaṁ.
verses.english: “Reverends, a mendicant with six qualities is good enough for themselves and others.
What six?

verses.pali: Idhāvuso, bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu;
verses.english: A mendicant is quick-witted when it comes to skillful teachings.
They readily memorize the teachings they’ve heard.
They examine the meaning of teachings they’ve memorized.
Understanding the meaning and the teaching, they practice in line with the teaching.

verses.pali: kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo, poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā;
verses.english: They’re a good speaker who enunciates well. Their voice is polished, clear, articulate, and expresses the meaning.

verses.pali: sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṁsako sabrahmacārīnaṁ.
verses.english: They educate, encourage, fire up, and inspire their spiritual companions.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, āvuso, chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṁ attano, alaṁ paresaṁ.
verses.english: A mendicant with these six qualities is good enough for themselves and others.

verses.pali: Pañcahāvuso, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṁ attano, alaṁ paresaṁ.
verses.english: A mendicant with five qualities is good enough for themselves and others.
What five?

verses.pali: Idhāvuso, bhikkhu na heva kho khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu;
verses.english: A mendicant is not quick-witted when it comes to skillful teachings.
They readily memorize the teachings they’ve heard.
They examine the meaning of teachings they’ve memorized.
Understanding the meaning and the teaching, they practice in line with the teaching.
They’re a good speaker. Their voice is polished, clear, articulate, and expresses the meaning.
They educate, encourage, fire up, and inspire their spiritual companions.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, āvuso, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṁ attano, alaṁ paresaṁ.
verses.english: A mendicant with these five qualities is good enough for themselves and others.

verses.pali: Catūhāvuso, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṁ attano, nālaṁ paresaṁ.
verses.english: A mendicant with four qualities is good enough for themselves but not for others.
What four?

verses.pali: Idhāvuso, bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu;
verses.english: A mendicant is quick-witted when it comes to skillful teachings.
They readily memorize the teachings they’ve heard.
They examine the meaning of teachings they’ve memorized.
Understanding the meaning and the teaching, they practice in line with the teaching.
They’re not a good speaker. Their voice isn’t polished, clear, articulate, and doesn’t express the meaning.
They don’t educate, encourage, fire up, and inspire their spiritual companions.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, āvuso, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṁ attano, nālaṁ paresaṁ.
verses.english: A mendicant with these four qualities is good enough for themselves but not for others.
